cases.label: First Screen of a New Game Visual Identity
required_tools_ordered: parallax ui direct new (3-5 directions as world objects)
parallax ui refs <identity> (>=2 stills of exact screen type at >=1080p, 1:1 REFS.md)
parallax ui new screen + parallax ui gauge

forbidden_tools.why: Gallery/contact sheets at 760x940 cap are too small for hero detail; each piece needs 1:1 ref crops.
Typed glyphs + flat PIL rectangles read as AI slop — no visual language, no identity.
Using FLUX as a stand-in for known characters produces off-model renders that break the identity.

cases.capability_policy: Full-capability, case-matched execution (NEVER artificially minimal): use the ENTIRE pipeline whenever the piece benefits from it; `required_tools_ordered` is the quality floor, extra non-forbidden pipeline tools are ALWAYS allowed, `forbidden_tools` blocks ONLY tools that degrade this case, and edge-case skips require `--skip-tool <tool> --why "<reason>"` logged to `.verify/parallax_session.json`.
examples: create the first hero-screen for a new game-identity with ink and letter pieces
build a new-identity screen from scratch with owner direction and 1080p refs
design an original game ui-identity title screen with 3 directions, refs and a hero route

cases.label: High-Style Anime / Character-Action HUD (Persona, Strive)
required_tools_ordered: official 2D key art through parallax ui ink --mode cel
parallax ui reel (ghost drain, rolling counters, hits)

forbidden_tools.why: 3D render through halftone filter produces a 'splat' that is not stylized anime — it is a mock-up not a real technique.
A single display face for a Persona-style screen misses the multi-panel layout fundamental to that style.
Torn plate patterns for P5 style must be built with letter/ink, not PIL crop transforms.
Ransom lettering on item/skill lists creates unreadable UI; use letter only on hero type.
